test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Why does the passage refer to mental health care as a “complicated story”?

options.text: Because most of the mental health problems are solved with just one intervention and regular medication.
Because it must address emotional, relational, practical, and existential needs all at once.
Because care should keep away from the real-life situation.
Because mental health is a matter of medical diagnosis only.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To understand why the passage uses the phrase **"very complicated story,"** we look at the final sentence which lists the overlapping tasks of care.
 
• The author explains that a radical vision requires addressing: 
 
 
• **Adverse life circumstances:** Practical needs and security.
 
• **Relationship issues:** Social and emotional needs.
 
• **Existential issues:** Deep mental and philosophical suffering.
 
• **Daily accomplishment:** Problem-solving and functional needs.
 
 
 
• The simultaneous management of all these diverse layers—emotional, relational, practical, and existential—is what makes the process "complicated."
 
• Why other options are incorrect: 
 
 
• **Option 1:** This **contradicts** the text. The passage describes a need for being there "again and again" through various sufferings, which is the opposite of a "one-off" intervention or simple medication.
 
• **Option 3:** The passage explicitly states that care **is** the task of addressing "adverse life circumstances," meaning it must be deeply involved in real-life situations.
 
• **Option 4:** This is a **narrow view** that the passage is trying to move away from by focusing on "dignity," "disability justice," and "existential issues" rather than just a medical diagnosis.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **2**.

 

**Analytical Insight:** *In high-level Reading Comprehension, "Complexity" usually arises from the **intersection** of different factors. When a text lists multiple categories of needs that must be addressed at the same time, the "complication" lies in that holistic approach.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Existential:** Relating to human existence or the experience of being alive.
 
• **Equity:** The quality of being fair and impartial, ensuring everyone has what they need to succeed.
 
• **Disability Justice:** A movement that acknowledges that all bodies are unique and that social systems must be built to include everyone.
 
• **Adverse:** Preventing success or development; harmful; unfavorable.
